preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.languageHelp: Falco, your emails and the product use this language.
preferences.newLanguageNotice: English is now available. You can change the interface language here at any time.

page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Your account, Anthropic key and integrations.
page.profileHelp: Your photo and display name, shown in the left menu.
page.businessHelp: Describe your offer, acquisition and delivery so Minaly can calculate your numbers.
page.anthropicKeyHelp: Your agent always uses your own key: never shared, never displayed in plain text.
page.keyInvalid: This key was revoked or expired on Anthropic. Generate a new one below to use your insights again.
page.keyUnreadableTitle: Your saved key could not be read
page.keyUnreadable: The server encryption key changed after it was saved. Your stored key is unusable: enter it again below to restore your insights.
page.getKeyStep1End: and sign in (or create an account).
page.getKeyStep2: Add a few dollars of credit in Billing. Without it, the API rejects every call.
page.getKeyStep3: In API Keys, click Create Key, give it a name such as Minaly, and copy the value starting with sk-ant-.
page.getKeyStep4: Paste it below. It will never be shown in plain text again once saved.
page.billingHelp: Your Minaly subscription is required to invite team members.
page.teamHelp: Invite members, assign roles such as setting, closing or finance, and configure access for each role.
page.integrationsHelp: Stripe, iClosed, Calendly, Instagram and YouTube are the sources for your diagnostic.
page.unsupportedFormat: Unsupported format (including HEIC). Use JPG, PNG or WebP.
page.imageTooLarge: Image is too large (2 MB maximum).
page.imageHelp: JPG, PNG or WebP, 2 MB maximum.
page.nameHelp: Used to welcome you on the Dashboard, in the menu and by Falco when he talks to you.
page.reduceAnimationsHelp: Falco stays present but animates his bubbles less (independent of your system settings).
page.resetDataHelp: Erases your figures, diagnostic, journal and team. Your account, API key and Stripe connection stay intact. You return to onboarding as a new account.
page.resetConfirmHelp: This permanently erases your figures (Setting/Closing/Datas), diagnostic, business profile, imports, journal (projects, to-dos, notes) and team (roles, invited members).
page.resetConfirmKeep: Kept intact: your email, Anthropic API key, Stripe connection and Minaly subscription.
page.deleteAccountHelp: Permanent and irreversible deletion: your account, all data, Stripe connection and Minaly subscription.
page.deleteConfirmHelp: Irreversible. Your Minaly subscription is cancelled, your Stripe connection revoked, and everything (figures, diagnostic, journal, team, API key) is deleted. You will no longer be able to sign in with this account.

team.subtitle: Invite members and assign one or more roles. Configure each role’s access below.
team.subscriptionHelp: Team members require an active Minaly subscription that includes this feature.
team.rolesHelp: Choose the areas each role can access. Changes save automatically for all members with that role.
team.accessHelp: Select the areas this role can use. Each change saves automatically.
team.manualInviteHelp: The email could not be sent (Resend is not configured). Share this invitation link manually:
